admin_server.description: Hostname or IP address of the Kerberos admin server (for password changes, etc.).

cache.description: Caching configuration for LDAP and Kerberos lookups.

encryption_types.description: List of allowed encryption types (cipher suites), ordered by preference.

kdc.description: Hostname or IP address of the KDC server for the realm.

keytab.description: Path to keytab file for service principal authentication. Leave blank if not used.

krb5_conf.description: Path to the system Kerberos configuration file.

ldap.description: LDAP integration configuration for group mapping.

bind_dn.description: DN to bind to LDAP (leave empty for anonymous bind).

bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind. Leave blank if anonymous.

group_attr.description: LDAP attribute listing group members (e.g., memberUid or member).

group_filter.description: LDAP filter for group lookups. Use %s as placeholder for username.

principal_attr.description: LDAP attribute storing Kerberos principal (e.g., krbPrincipalName).

uris.description: LDAP server URIs (supports ldap:// or ldaps://).

user_filter.description: LDAP filter for user lookups. Use %s as placeholder for Kerberos principal.

username_attr.description: LDAP attribute storing the Unix username (e.g., uid).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warning, error).

max_ttl.description: Maximum renewable ticket lifetime in seconds.

realm.description: Kerberos realm used for authentication (e.g., the institution's realm).

service_principal.description: Kerberos service principal (used with keytab if provided).
